name: Gemeente Zwolle
description: Gemeente Zwolle's own design tokens: dark blue buttons and table headers on white.
_comment_source: Derived from @nl-design-system-unstable/zwolle-design-tokens 1.0.0 (https://registry.npmjs.org/@nl-design-system-unstable/zwolle-design-tokens/-/zwolle-design-tokens-1.0.0.tgz), Ruben's decision of 19 Nov 2026.
The package ships its own --utrecht-* component mapping (the .zwolle-theme rule), which is section B. The
ramp maps three published colours onto the role layer's steps of the same role, naming the token each is
read from; every other step is left to Nextcloud. Colours are the package's hsl() converted to hex
(round to nearest per channel), because the contrast engine reads hex.

semantic._comment: From: utrecht-button-background-color (zwolle-color-blue-50), utrecht-button-color (white), utrecht-document-color (black). background-dark is zwolle-color-grey: the converter would read the table header's blue there, and black text on that blue measures 4.15:1.
